# Optional Codex companion

Omarchy Watch no longer installs or modifies Codex hooks. Codex activity and
completion alerts remain available through the optional
[Omarchy Watch for Codex](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch-codex)
companion, installed and managed separately with explicit opt-in.

Existing v0.5.2 Codex hooks are left untouched during an update, so existing
alerts continue working. Remove those legacy hook entries before installing the
companion to avoid running both integrations.

Firmware behavior is unchanged from v0.5.2. The v0.5.3 flash bundle preserves
pairing and watch settings during an upgrade.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#install)
for complete setup instructions.
